versions.title: RINA — Character Introduction Rap
versions.subtitle: Official MV — English Ver.
versions.description:
Music producer. Gamer. Night owl.
RINA introduces herself through the things she loves, the people around her, and the human world she is still discovering.
She can do almost anything.
What she is still looking for is something that truly moves her.
